What Merlin is

Merlin, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRLN) builds Merlin Pilot, an aircraft-agnostic autonomy system meant to fly existing fixed-wing aircraft from takeoff to touchdown, with or without a human crew, for defense and civil use. The operating company is Merlin Labs, Inc.; the public parent is Merlin, Inc. after the March 2026 business combination. (company site · closing 8-K 20 Mar 2026)

C-130J SOCOM IDIQ

Sole-source IDIQ H9240824D0001 (“Automated Crew & Workload”), signed 7 Jun 2024. Ceiling $105M; ordering period through 6 Apr 2029 on the award record. About $15.96M obligated on the PDR/CDR order (H9240824F0010); that order’s period of performance ended 31 Jul 2026. Stages 3–7 were unfunded as of the 13 May 2026 prospectus. Remaining performance obligations at 30 Jun 2026 were $593 thousand. On 15 Sep 2026 at AFA ASC, CEO Matt George said Merlin had taken its SOCOM autonomy system through CDR and PDR and described takeoff-to-touchdown autonomy flying an operational aircraft as near, with nothing further announced yet. (USAspending IDIQ · PDR/CDR order · prospectus 13 May 2026 · 10-Q · ACC AI panel 15 Sep 2026)

KC-135 + GE Aerospace

Merlin has described progress integrating on the KC-135 with the U.S. Air Force, and a 23 Sep 2025 joint release with GE Aerospace on an “autonomy core” collaboration naming the KC-135 Center Console Refresh as the first teaming opportunity. The prospectus says the teaming agreement runs 36 months and ends in 2028 unless extended. (GE/Merlin PR 23 Sep 2025 · prospectus)

SkyCourier UX with Textron

On 14 Sep 2026, Textron Aviation and Merlin introduced a Cessna SkyCourier UX concept at Air, Space & Cyber. Design objectives cited (~6,000 lb payload, up to three LD3 containers) are design objectives for a concept aircraft. Merlin 14 Sep 2026 · Merlin 18 Sep 2026

Civil certification (after 9 Sep 2026)

On 9 Sep 2026 Merlin said it is shutting down the small-aircraft New Zealand CAA certification program and concentrating civil certification investment on large aircraft, building on C-130J work. Kerikeri remains the flight-test center; Merlin intends commercial operations there under CAANZ Part 107, with no year attached in that note. CEO note 9 Sep 2026

How it went public

Merlin listed through a SPAC merger with Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. IV (formerly Bleichroeder Acquisition Corp. I). The business combination agreement was signed 13 Aug 2025 at an $800M pre-money equity value. Shareholders voted on 12 Mar 2026; the deal closed 16 Mar 2026; Nasdaq trading as MRLN began 17 Mar 2026.

About 90% of public Class A shares were redeemed (22,550,551 of 25,000,000). Net cash at close was about $94.7M after trust proceeds, a $120M closing PIPE (including $100M from Alyeska), transaction expenses, and repayment of the 2024 loan facility. The SPAC issued rights (BACQR), not public warrants. (closing 8-K 20 Mar 2026 · Apr 21 424B3)

Capital structure and ownership

  • Common shares: 100,592,160 issued and outstanding at 30 Jun 2026; 101,067,784 noted around 11 Aug 2026 in the same 10-Q. Closing-day sources also print either 84,262,886 or 84,540,978 — the filings disagree. (Q2 10-Q · closing 8-K)
  • Series A preferred: 18,649,567 outstanding at 30 Jun 2026 after conversions; 12.0% cumulative convertible preferred with a conversion price reset mechanism. (Q2 10-Q)
  • Private PIPE warrants: 36,116,246 Series A warrants plus 4,000,000 May PIPE warrants (40,116,246 total), strike $6.67 after the May down-round reset, expiry in 2031. Filings conflict on the May PIPE warrant day (29 Apr 2031 in the May prospectus vs 1 May 2031 in the Q2 10-Q). (Q2 10-Q · May 13 prospectus)
  • May 2026 Alyeska PIPE: SPA signed 29 Apr 2026; closed 1 May 2026 — 8,000,000 common shares at $10 ($80M) plus warrants on 4,000,000 shares at $6.67. Preferred conversion and warrant strikes reset from $12 to $6.67, producing a $60.8M deemed dividend. (8-K 29 Apr 2026 · Q2 10-Q)
  • No listed warrants: MRLN common only. SPAC rights converted; Series A / May PIPE warrants are private. (Apr 21 424B3)
  • Lockup: Six-month lockup for sponsor founder shares and Merlin lock-up holders ended around 16 Sep 2026. That day First Round funds distributed roughly 11.75M common shares to LPs and the sponsor distributed 8,333,333 founder shares to members. (closing 8-K · Forms 4 / 13G/A filed 18 Sep 2026)
  • Resale registration: Apr 21 prospectus registered up to about 157.7M secondary common shares under Reg. No. 333-295068. Sponsor founder share cost basis about $0.004. (Apr 21 424B3)
  • Other dilutives at 30 Jun 2026: 8,172,229 options (WAEP $4.18); 3,866,520 unvested RSUs. (Q2 10-Q)

Revenue concentration

More than 90% of revenue comes from U.S. government work, led by the USSOCOM C-130J IDIQ. Remaining performance obligations were $593K at 30 Jun 2026. Contract number H9240824D0001 is from USAspending / SAM; it does not appear in the SEC filings reviewed for this brief. (Q2 10-Q · USAspending)

Certification history

  • Sep 2021: Company announced FAA / CAANZ agreement on a certification basis for takeoff-to-touchdown autonomy (restated in later company materials). This brief does not treat any FAA G-1 issue paper as confirmed for Merlin. (PR Newswire 13 Jul 2022)
  • SOI path (CAANZ, Caravan / Part 23): SOI 1 ~May 2023; SOI 2 Oct 2025; SOI 3 announced 6 Aug 2026 with a Stage 4 AI/ML NLP issue paper. (Merlin SOI-3 note)
  • CAANZ Part 146 Aircraft Design Organization designation announced 24 Mar 2026; Experimental Certificate of Airworthiness used to accelerate certification flight testing. (Part 146 · Experimental CoA)
  • 9 Sep 2026: Small-aircraft NZ certification program shut down; civil capital pivoted to large aircraft. Kerikeri remains the flight-test / Pacific demo base; Part 107 commercial-ops intent retained without a restated year. (9 Sep note)
  • 17 Jul 2026: Autonomous Cessna 208B landing at EAA AirVenture Oshkosh (safety pilot aboard). (Merlin 24 Jul 2026)
  • 15 Sep 2026 (ACC AI panel): George described Merlin’s military certification approach as putting “highly non-explainable systems” into “highly deterministic boxes” for AFMC/LCMC comfort, plus 1553-bus interoperability with legacy primes on C-130 and KC-135 airframes. (ACC AI panel video)
  • Merlin’s C-130J work is the USSOCOM Automated Crew & Workload IDIQ. This brief does not link Merlin to Lockheed ITMS as a performer. (USAspending)

Board of directors

Seven directors named 16 Apr 2026 (six independent under Nasdaq rules). George is combined Chair and CEO; Michael Blitzer is Lead Independent Director. (Board PR 16 Apr 2026 · May 13 prospectus)

Michael Blitzer Lead Independent Director

Founder and co-CEO of Kingstown Capital; Inflection Point SPAC franchise that took Intuitive Machines (LUNR) and USA Rare Earth (USAR) public. He remains on both boards (USAR as chairman). As Lead Independent Director opposite a combined Chair/CEO, he is the main independent check in the room while Merlin settles into Nasdaq life.

Fine print: Merlin’s charter renounces certain corporate opportunities for non-employee directors (standard SPAC-era pattern). Blitzer-linked entities hold sponsor founder shares; exact share counts in company filings.

Kenneth Braithwaite Independent Director

77th Secretary of the Navy (May 2020–Jan 2021); U.S. Ambassador to Norway; career Naval Aviator who retired as Rear Admiral / Vice Chief of Information. Now chairs Fincantieri Marine Group and advises defense tech names. Useful for Navy and SOCOM customer fluency while Merlin pushes C-130J autonomy and other government programs.

Dr. Robert H. Smith Independent Director

CEO of Blue Origin from Sep 2017 to Jan 2024; earlier Honeywell Aerospace leadership including CTO and President of Mechanical Systems & Components. Now on the Parsons (PSN) board. Hardware scale-up and certification experience that maps to Merlin’s large-aircraft path, including the Honeywell partnership.

Kelyn Brannon Independent Director · Audit Chair

Amazon’s first Chief Accounting Officer; later CFO roles including Arista and Astra’s SPAC listing. Designated audit committee financial expert. The controls and reporting experience a first-year public company needs while Merlin staffs up finance and legal.

Michael Montelongo Independent Director

19th Assistant Secretary of the Air Force for Financial Management and USAF CFO (2001–2005); West Point instructor; NACD board member; Harvard Business School lecturer/fellow. Air Force budget and acquisition fluency for a company whose revenue is still overwhelmingly U.S. government work.

Carolyn Trabuco Independent Director · Compensation Chair

Co-founded Azul Brazilian Airlines and served as a director until Apr 2025; sits on USA Rare Earth’s board with Blitzer; capital-markets and airline-operations background via Thistledown Advisory. Useful when Merlin talks civil cargo / Condor economics and public-company compensation governance.

Committee seats per May 2026 prospectus: Audit — Brannon (chair), Montelongo, Trabuco; Compensation — Trabuco (chair), Brannon, Smith; Nominating & Governance — Blitzer (chair), Braithwaite, Montelongo. Matt George remains on the board as Chairman (see executives above).

Section 2

Forward thesis

A confident, sourced view. Not investment advice.

Merlin looks one headline away from a clearer public proof point: funded integration and ground test on the C-130J path, or a dated large-aircraft civil-cert milestone that replaces the small-aircraft file it closed.

The company already has a named defense spine (USSOCOM C-130J IDIQ with PDR and CDR done), a large cash balance relative to early revenue, and partners (GE, Textron concept, IAI MOU) that keep it in front of operators and regulators. What remains missing in the public award record, as pulled 4–5 Oct 2026, is a funded successor order after the design-phase task that ended 31 Jul 2026. The prospectus said Stages 3–7 were unfunded as of 13 May 2026. (USAspending · prospectus · 8-K exhibit 13 Aug 2026)

What would prove it

  • A dated, funded C-130J integration / ground-test task order (or clear 10-Q language that Stages 3+ are funded), then flight-test evidence with dates beyond the phrase “closer to deployment.” (Aug earnings framing)
  • A published large-aircraft civil certification milestone (application, issue paper, SOI, or authority schedule) that replaces the retired small-aircraft path. (9 Sep strategy)
  • KC-135 / GE CCR progress that moves from teaming language to a named Air Force award or dated flight-test window. (GE teaming)

What would change the picture

  • Warrant / preferred conversion reset around mid-October 2026 printing at or near the $5.00 floor, expanding potential dilution math already visible in the resale registrations. (Q2 10-Q warrant note)
  • Lockup overhang continuing to trade after the 16 Sep 2026 First Round and sponsor distributions. (Forms 4 / 13G/A filed 18 Sep 2026)
  • Another PIPE or equity raise before either the defense or civil path prints hard evidence, against Q2 losses and material-weakness disclosures. (Q2 10-Q)
  • Silence on the USSOCOM vehicle while the ordering window runs toward 6 Apr 2029, or a civil-cert stall after the 9 Sep pivot with no successor milestone for multiple quarters.

What would break it

  • Stop-work or multi-quarter silence on the USSOCOM vehicle with no integration funding visible. (IDIQ end date)
  • Civil cert stall after the 9 Sep pivot: large-aircraft strategy announced, then no successor milestone. (9 Sep note)
  • Cash burn that forces a distressed raise before either path prints hard evidence (Q2 showed heavy losses against $183.6M cash). (Q2 10-Q)
How to read this. “One headline away” means the next primary disclosure could re-rate how the market prices the process. There is no promised next headline, and this brief does not forecast price or give buy/sell advice.

    Merlin said · estimated Filing formula

    Warrant strike and preferred conversion reset window

    The Q2 10-Q describes a reset on the 21st trading day after the date that is six months after closing. Closing was 16 Mar 2026, so the six-month anniversary is 16 Sep 2026; the measurement window falls around mid-October 2026 (about 15 Oct 2026 if counted as the 21st trading day after 16 Sep). If the 20-day VWAP is below the then-current price, the strike / conversion resets to the greater of that VWAP and a $5.00 floor. At recent prices near $1.71, the reset may hit that floor. This date is estimated from the filing’s formula; Merlin has not published a calendar notice of the exact reset day.

    Q2 10-Q warrant note

  • 11 December 2026
    Industry / military context

    FY2027 continuing resolution ends

    The FY2027 continuing resolution (P.L. 119-103, H.R. 6500, signed 2 September 2026) funds federal agencies, including defense, at FY2026 levels until full-year FY2027 appropriations pass or this date, whichever comes first. If neither a new bill nor another stopgap passes, funding lapses 12 December. Under the CR, DoD cannot start projects that lacked FY2026 funding (Sec. 104), so a brand-new funded Merlin program before full-year appropriations is unlikely. Work already funded can continue.
